source_provenance.source_summary: The paper consistently reports a cube attack on 14-round reduced SNOW 2.0 with time complexity exponent 61.59 and chosen-IV exponent 39.
The table reports DS-MITM attacks on LBlock, TWINE80, TWINE128, and SKINNY-128-384 with total attacked rounds 21, 20, 25, and 22 respectively.
A 2-round Keccak-384 preimage attack has time complexity 2^89 and memory complexity 2^87, improving the previous 2^129 result.
The attack summary includes 6-round AE/hash attacks, 9-round impossible differential and zero-correlation distinguishers, 17-round zero-sum distinguishers, and 15-round rebound attacks.
The GIFT 4-bit S-box maps 0..f to 1,a,4,c,6,f,3,9,2,d,b,7,5,0,8,e and has maximum nonzero DDT entry 6.
The allocating approach gives 3-round Keccak-224 complexity 2^38, 3-round Keccak-256 complexity 2^81, and 4-round complexities 2^207/2^239 for Keccak-224/256.
The paper reports a 5-round AES key-independent zero-difference distinguisher with 2^27.2 ACC and a secret-sbox key-recovery attack with 2^29.19 CP plus 2^32 ACC.
The paper reports 2-round Troika preimage complexity 3^79, 3-round preimage complexity 3^217.3, and gives the tryte S-box plus RotateWest constants used by the permutation.

The paper reports SipHash colliding and RX-colliding characteristics including probability 2^-278 for SipHash-1-x DC with four blocks, 2^-280 for SipHash-1-x RX with two blocks, and revised SipHash-1-x RX characteristics of 2^-93.6 and 2^-160.

source_provenance.source_summary: G1 reaches 4 MiB after a 2^13 reduction, while G2-2 reduces 32 GiB to 64 MiB, a factor of 512.
The reported 4-round preimage complexities are 2^182 bit operations for Keccak-224, 2^214 for Keccak-256, and about 2^19 permutation calls for the challenge instance.
The PIPO-64/128 DFA uses 32 faulty ciphertexts for each of two rounds and reaches about 98.8% success with four differential observations.
The simple slide attack requires 2^65 known-plaintext queries, 2^65 computations, and 2^64 memory.
The first 7-round Whirlpool preimage attack has time 2^480; the 6-round attack has time 2^440 and memory 2^192.
The 3-round SPEEDY key-recovery attack has time 2^52.52, data 2^17.58, and memory 2^25.16 bits.
The related-key boomerang attack uses 2^92 plaintexts and ciphertexts, 2^92.5 equivalent encryptions, and 2^89 bytes.
A GIFT S-box quantum circuit uses 4 Toffoli, 2 CNOT, and 6 Pauli-X gates.
The 15-round attack has data 2^24, time 2^33.90, and about 88% success.
The four-round truncated differential probability is 2^-8+2^-31.654, and the distinguisher uses about 2^50.738 chosen plaintexts at success probability 0.95.
A successful LowMC attack requires 2^(1.86mr1-3tau)<2^k, 2^(1.86mr2)<2^k, and 2^(1.86m(r1+r2)-3tau)<=2^n.
The pruned transform uses |L|+t*2^t+|M| additions and 2^t memory registers.
A generic forgery takes O(2^(3c/4)) time, negligible memory, and no encryption queries.
The 36-round RIPEMD-160 collision attack has time 2^64.5 and memory about 2^24.
The Grain v1 near-collision attack targets difference 0^80||e79 and has total complexity about 2^74.6 encryptions.
